name: robots/noetix-robotics__noetix_n2_gym
title: Noetix N2 humanoid, 18-DoF MuJoCo model
intro: Noetix N2 humanoid, 18-DoF MuJoCo model, adapted from noetix-robotics/noetix_n2_gym. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
